units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 41a:6">Ab. Zar. 41ᵃ</cite> <he>מעיקרא סבור א׳ וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A03377"><he>אִישְׁתַּיָּימָא</he></cite>) at first it was thought the ring in the hand of a statue was a mere distinction (not typical of any religious idea), but afterwards it was found out that (it represents the idea that) he (the bearer of it) seals himself for death as a vicarious sacrifice for the whole world.
